title: Reviewer Bulletin: Other-Insurer Payment and the Explanation of Benefits on a Reconsidered TRICARE Select Line (Appeals and Grievances)
content:
## Reviewer bulletin — Appeals and Grievances: counting another insurer's payment on the case's line

For a formal review asked for on a decided Claim Factual Reconsideration of a TRICARE Select line denied for late filing.

> The other insurer's payment counted on the case's line is taken as follows: where the case holds the other insurer's explanation of benefits, other health insurance is on file for the patient and the case's line itself shows the other insurer's payment, that payment is counted; where the case holds the other insurer's explanation of benefits, other health insurance is on file, the case's line shows no such payment and an earlier posting of the same service date on the same claim shows one, the largest payment shown on the claim's postings of that service date is counted; in every other case no payment by another insurer is counted.

Records read: whether the patient's active TRICARE Select enrollment shows other health insurance on file; the amount other health insurance paid first as shown on the case's line's own TRICARE Select record (a payment is shown when that amount is above zero); and the same amount on the claim's other postings with the same service date. "The case holds the other insurer's explanation of benefits" means an explanation of benefits is recorded among the documents received for the case.

| Explanation of benefits received on the case | Other health insurance on file | Payment shown on the line | Payment shown on an earlier posting of that service date | Payment counted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | any | the payment shown on the line |
| yes | yes | no | yes | the largest payment shown on the claim's postings of that service date |
| yes | yes | no | no | none (0.00) |
| yes | no | any | any | none (0.00) |
| no | any | any | any | none (0.00) |

*Hypothetical:* an explanation of benefits received on the case; other health insurance on file; the line shows 0.00; two earlier postings of the same service date on the claim show 35.00 and 52.40. The payment counted is 52.40, the largest shown. Had other health insurance not been on file, nothing would be counted, whatever the postings show.
